ORDER Date : 20-02-2023 Heard Mr. A.T. Sarkar, learned counsel for the applicant along with Mrs. S. Roy,
learned counsel for respondent No.1.
This is an application filed under Section 151 of CPC seeking for slight modification in the Order of this Court in MAC.

Appeal No. 417/2017 dated 01.11.2022, wherein this Court have passed an Order while dismissing the appeal, that the Insurance Company was to be deposited amount of Rs.8,08,250/- only in the saving accounts of the claimant/wife i.e. Smt.Jamuna Mandal through NEFT.

The amount of compensation shall carrying interest @ 6 % per annum from the date of filing of the case till the full and final realisation.
Page No.# 1/6 vs National Insurance Company Limited on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/141605179/

4 The learned counsel for the applicant submits that the Insurance Company Page No.# 6/6 usually make such payment of the money by releasing the money to the MAC Claims Tribunal instead of releasing money directing to claimant, thus, the Order dated 01.11.2022 passed by this court may accordingly be modified for the convenience of both the parties.

Mrs. S. Roy, learned counsel for the Insurance Company also submits that it will be the interest of the claimant and also more convenient for the Insurance Company if the said amount is deposited before the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal No.1 Kamrup, Guwahati.
